description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SavingsAccountDebitsBlockedException' which extends a base exception 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException'. It is used to indicate that debit transactions on a savings account are not allowed due to blocking conditions.

classes.name: SavingsAccountDebitsBlockedException
classes.description: A specific exception indicating that debit transactions are blocked for a savings account.

methods.name: SavingsAccountDebitsBlockedException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a standardized error message indicating debit operations are not allowed on the blocked account.
